name: Inaugural Cup (beta)
about: The first official ACR Daily cup, in beta: free to enter, with 1,000 credits from ACR Daily for the top four. A knockout of 1V1s, seeded by driver rating. Each match is a short Monte Carlo rally: Turini Montée and Mézien - St. Geniez on day 1, the Turini descent in the evening on day 2, in a Rally2 car of your choice. Drive it from the app's LEAGUES view whenever you like during the round's week. Beta: things may change and bugs are expected, so tell us on Discord.
